Axis keys are taken from this suite because its test names carry machine-readable ids (N4, N4b, N4c, N4d); the sibling set-body.integration.test.ts uses prose names, so its redness is visible as a failing suite but not extractable by red_re (§A47 — the axis NAME is the machine key).
